```{r}
#| title: Setup & Library Load

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

```

```{r}
#| title: Data Import & Merging

# Load datasets
path_3 <- "C:/Users/pedro/Documents/2026/Mestrado/jade-line-bkps/jade-line-impact/data/processed/02_master_sample_table-9s.rds"
path_1 <- "D:/jade-line-impact/jade-line-impact/data/processed/02_master_sample_table-9s.rds"

match3 <- readRDS(path_3)
match1 <- readRDS(path_1)

# Define columns to merge on and core metrics to analyze
join_keys <- c("Strata", "Match_Type", "Year")
metrics <- c("DiD_Ext_Estimate", "DiD_Ext_PValue", "DiD_Int_Estimate", "DiD_Int_PValue")

# Join into a single master frame and isolate the post-treatment period
master_comp_post <- match3 %>%
  select(all_of(c(join_keys, metrics))) %>%
  inner_join(
    match1 %>% select(all_of(c(join_keys, metrics))),
    by = join_keys,
    suffix = c("_3", "_1")
  ) %>%
  filter(Year == 2023) # Filters out pre-treatment years (1997, 2007, 2017)

```

```{r}
#| title: Reshaping for Analysis

# Define alpha for significance
alpha_level <- 0.10

# A. Ratio Comparison Data (Flagging 1:1 vs 1:3 significance)
ratio_data <- master_comp_post %>%
  mutate(
    Abs_Diff_Ext = DiD_Ext_Estimate_3 - DiD_Ext_Estimate_1,
    Pct_Diff_Ext = (Abs_Diff_Ext / DiD_Ext_Estimate_1) * 100,
    
    # Create categorical significance flag
    Sig_1 = DiD_Ext_PValue_1 < alpha_level,
    Sig_3 = DiD_Ext_PValue_3 < alpha_level,
    Significance = case_when(
      Sig_1 & Sig_3   ~ "Significant in Both",
      !Sig_1 & !Sig_3 ~ "Not Significant",
      Sig_1 & !Sig_3  ~ "Significant only in 1:1",
      !Sig_1 & Sig_3  ~ "Significant only in 1:3"
    ),
    # Lock the factor levels for consistent legend ordering
    Significance = factor(Significance, levels = c("Significant in Both", "Significant only in 1:3", "Significant only in 1:1", "Not Significant"))
  )

# B. Algorithm Comparison Data (Flagging Logit vs Mahalanobis significance)
algo_data <- master_comp_post %>%
  select(Strata, Year, Match_Type, 
         DiD_Ext_Estimate_1, DiD_Ext_Estimate_3,
         DiD_Ext_PValue_1, DiD_Ext_PValue_3) %>%
  # Rename to simplify the simultaneous pivot of estimates and p-values
  rename(
    Estimate_1 = DiD_Ext_Estimate_1, Estimate_3 = DiD_Ext_Estimate_3,
    PValue_1 = DiD_Ext_PValue_1, PValue_3 = DiD_Ext_PValue_3
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(Estimate_1, Estimate_3, PValue_1, PValue_3),
    names_to = c(".value", "Ratio"),
    names_sep = "_"
  ) %>%
  mutate(Ratio = ifelse(Ratio == "1", "1:1 Ratio", "1:3 Ratio")) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Match_Type,
    values_from = c(Estimate, PValue)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Abs_Diff_Algo = Estimate_Mahalanobis - Estimate_Logit,
    
    # Create categorical significance flag for algorithms
    Sig_Logit = PValue_Logit < alpha_level,
    Sig_Mahal = PValue_Mahalanobis < alpha_level,
    Significance = case_when(
      Sig_Logit & Sig_Mahal   ~ "Significant in Both",
      !Sig_Logit & !Sig_Mahal ~ "Not Significant",
      Sig_Logit & !Sig_Mahal  ~ "Significant only in Logit",
      !Sig_Logit & Sig_Mahal  ~ "Significant only in Mahalanobis"
    ),
    Significance = factor(Significance, levels = c("Significant in Both", "Significant only in Mahalanobis", "Significant only in Logit", "Not Significant"))
  )


```


```{r}
#| title: Numerical Diagnostics (RMSE & Divergence Summaries)
#| eval: false

# Quantify how much 1:3 drifts from 1:1, separated by matching algorithm
ratio_summary <- ratio_data %>%
  group_by(Match_Type) %>%
  summarise(
    Mean_Estimate_1 = mean(DiD_Ext_Estimate_1, na.rm = TRUE),
    Mean_Estimate_3 = mean(DiD_Ext_Estimate_3, na.rm = TRUE),
    RMSE_Ratio      = sqrt(mean(Abs_Diff_Ext^2, na.rm = TRUE)),
    Max_Abs_Drift   = max(abs(Abs_Diff_Ext), na.rm = TRUE)
  )

# Quantify how much Mahalanobis drifts from Logit, separated by Ratio
algo_summary <- algo_data %>%
  group_by(Ratio) %>%
  summarise(
    Mean_Logit       = mean(Logit, na.rm = TRUE),
    Mean_Mahalanobis = mean(Mahalanobis, na.rm = TRUE),
    RMSE_Algo        = sqrt(mean(Abs_Diff_Algo^2, na.rm = TRUE)),
    Max_Abs_Drift    = max(abs(Abs_Diff_Algo), na.rm = TRUE)
  )

print("--- Stability Across Ratios (1:1 vs 1:3) ---")
print(ratio_summary)
print("--- Stability Across Algorithms (Logit vs Mahalanobis) ---")
print(algo_summary)

```

```{r}
#| title: Visualizations

# Define a custom color palette for significance states
sig_colors <- c(
  "Significant in Both" = "#27ae60",       # Green
  "Significant only in 1:3" = "#d35400",   # Orange
  "Significant only in 1:1" = "#f39c12",   # Yellow
  "Significant only in Mahalanobis" = "#9b59b6", # Purple
  "Significant only in Logit" = "#e74c3c",       # Red
  "Not Significant" = "#bdc3c7"            # Gray
)

# Base theme
theme_jade <- theme_light() +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold", color = "white"),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "#2c3e50"),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

# Plot A: Ratio Stability (Faceted by Algorithm, Colored by Significance)
p_ratio <- ggplot(ratio_data, aes(x = DiD_Ext_Estimate_1, y = DiD_Ext_Estimate_3, 
                                  color = Significance, shape = Significance)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.8, size = 3) +
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "#2c3e50", linewidth = 0.8) +
  scale_color_manual(values = sig_colors) +
  # Use solid circles for both/neither, triangles/squares for mixed results
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(16, 17, 15, 1)) + 
  facet_wrap(~Match_Type) +
  labs(
    title = "Estimate Stability (2023): 1:1 vs 1:3 Matching Ratio",
    subtitle = "Dashed line denotes perfect agreement. Colors map to p < 0.10",
    x = "External DiD Estimate (1:1)",
    y = "External DiD Estimate (1:3)",
    color = "Significance (p < 0.05)",
    shape = "Significance (p < 0.05)"
  ) +
  theme_jade

# Plot B: Algorithm Stability (Faceted by Ratio, Colored by Significance)
p_algo <- ggplot(algo_data, aes(x = Estimate_Logit, y = Estimate_Mahalanobis, 
                                color = Significance, shape = Significance)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.8, size = 3) +
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "#2c3e50", linewidth = 0.8) +
  scale_color_manual(values = sig_colors) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(16, 17, 15, 1)) +
  facet_wrap(~Ratio) +
  labs(
    title = "Algorithm Consistency (2023): Logit vs Mahalanobis",
    subtitle = "Dashed line denotes perfect agreement. Colors map to p < 0.10",
    x = "External DiD Estimate (Logit)",
    y = "External DiD Estimate (Mahalanobis)",
    color = "Significance (p < 0.05)",
    shape = "Significance (p < 0.05)"
  ) +
  theme_jade

# Render plots
print(p_ratio)
print(p_algo)

```
